note.en: The original Fleischmann 2022 catalogue explicitly equates 685404/685504 to wired MX622, 686101 to MX622N (p.16) and 686201 to MX622R (p.17). The ZIMO manual dated 19 August 2024 lists this MX622 family on p.3; p.69 documents the selected CV meanings. Documentary partial coverage for these four articles only: check the actual decoder firmware and hardware. No OEM defaults, sound CVs, extra output assumptions or automatic identification. Roco retail branding remains separate from ZIMO technical identity. CV17/18 form one address; no guessed per-byte range. CV7/CV8 describe reading here; write actions are not performed.
